current.text: He is not in the projected starting five. The projected starters are Maxey, Edgecombe, Brown, LeBron James and Embiid.
He has said himself that the young guy should start over him.
The Philadelphia guard rotation is crowded, and Nick Nurse gives his starters heavy minutes. This leaves little room for bench guards.
He is not a fantasy option at all.
It is unclear if he has anything left.

note: He is not worth drafting in our league. Both sites value him at 0 USD and rank him outside the 144 drafted players (Yahoo 293, ESPN 247). The projection of about 7.5 points and 1.1 threes per game gives no category a real lift, and the expert calls him not a fantasy option. Leave him on waivers. He would only matter if injuries opened real minutes in the Philadelphia guard rotation.
